name: LeetSwap WETH/SHARE pair fee-transfer drain
summary: LeetSwapV2Pair exposed its fee-transfer helper publicly without caller, token, or amount authorization. An unprivileged caller could move a pair's counterpart-token balance into its fees contract, synchronize the depleted reserve, and drain WETH through the resulting reserve distortion.

loss.notes: The pair sent 17.173863794881959064 WETH to the attack helper. Excluding the helper's identifiable 0.001 WETH setup-swap input leaves exact pre-recovery victim depletion of 17.172863794881959064 WETH, valued at DefiLlama's nearest observation of $1,860.95. The public fee-transfer call also moved the counterpart token into the pair's fees contract; that internal transfer is excluded because claim allocation and recoverability cannot be isolated from the receipts, so no speculative counterpart-token value is assigned.

ageReset.description: LeetSwap factory CREATE2 deployment of this immutable-bearing pair runtime. Archival code is absent in block 1974157 and hashes to 0x6cfc75d2fe72fda61bed69a65bea0942bf00db6c44f6c06d836b8323a30997fa at deployment and immediately before the incident; the pair has no proxy code-selection path.

sources.note: Campaign boundary: calldata enumeration of the original EOA's successful transactions shows 0xf0c2ed12a446713d6e38e7a4f0e05d45360ee9305b7d6e0b796fc44f848f6052 is the sole defect-executing drain transaction against pair 0x847ae7a90c5d509f9f68e76641f20b70615baf74; other LeetSwap pair deployments are separate records with separate losses and ages. Verified LeetSwapV2Pair source exposes _transferFeesSupportingTaxTokens(address,uint256) as a public function with no caller, token, or amount authorization. The transaction trace calls it for the counterpart-token balance, calls sync(), and then swaps the setup tokens for WETH at the corrupted reserves. Code history: factory 0x169c06b4cfb09bfd73a81e6f2bb1eb514d75bb19 CREATE2-deployed the pair in 0x647104a2fa568f1f181be512000bff231601e3161f8a641655c4deaa0e7a343e at block 1974158:11; archival code is empty in the preceding block and the immutable-bearing direct runtime hashes to 0x6cfc75d2fe72fda61bed69a65bea0942bf00db6c44f6c06d836b8323a30997fa at creation and before the anchor. Loss: receipt Transfer logs show exactly 17.173863794881959064 WETH leaving this pair for helper 0xea8f89f47f3d4293897b4fe8cb69b5c233b9f560. The counterpart-token transfer goes to the pair's own fees contract and is not valued because its claim allocation/recoverability is not isolated.

notes: This pair-specific record is part of a coordinated same-attacker LeetSwap umbrella. Loss is partitioned by pair deployment and is not duplicated across sibling records.
